name: tripwire
description: Holds destructive commands until you say so: rm -rf, force pushes, git reset --hard, DROP TABLE, curl | sh, sudo, chmod -R 777, edits to .env. One question in Claude's own dialog, fail-closed if the guard itself breaks, and a /tripwire log of every decision.

protectedBranches.title: Protected branches
protectedBranches.description: Comma-separated branch names a force push is always questioned on, and whose deletion is refused outright.

askForRm.title: Ask before rm -r inside the project
askForRm.description: Also hold a recursive rm of a path inside the working directory. Paths outside it, globs and the home directory are always held.

allowSudo.title: Allow sudo without asking
allowSudo.description: Let commands that start with sudo run without a question.
